item.title: fix(gateway): report plugin HTTP dispatch failures as 500 (#124033)
item.summary: fix(gateway): report plugin HTTP dispatch failures as 500 (#124033) * fix(gateway): preserve plugin HTTP failure ownership Plugin HTTP dispatch failures now reach the Gateway's bounded 500 response instead of falling through as an unclaimed 404 route. * test(gateway): assert plugin HTTP failure log * refactor(gateway): remove dead HTTP stage labels
